text_source: prepared/test.csv (not bundled; recover and verify with saved hash)
join_rule: One-to-one by record_id; source LLM_name equals saved true_label.
selection_scope: Post hoc purposive qualitative illustrations after evaluation; no test filtering, new model selection, or retraining.
quote_caveat: Quoted text is a stored model response; its factual correctness is not independently verified or asserted.
score_caveat: Maximum softmax scores are uncalibrated classifier outputs, not established probabilities of real-world authorship.

exact_same_prompt_answer_summary.method: Group the 8,635 original test rows by exact (prompt_id, LLM_output), without normalization or truncation; retain groups with more than one record.
exact_same_prompt_answer_summary.caveat: Legitimate cross-model answer equality, not duplicated record IDs. Approximate matches and token-prefix collisions are not counted.

cases.selection_method: Selected post hoc to illustrate exact answer equality across generator labels within the same prompt; not a random or representative sample.
cases.prompt: What year was the municipality of Cáceres, Antioquia, Colombia, founded?
cases.brief_response_quote: The municipality of Cáceres, Antioquia, Colombia, was founded in **1576**.
cases.interpretation: Identical prompts and answers cannot both be attributed correctly to different labels by a deterministic text-only classifier. These are legitimate cross-model records, not duplicate data rows to delete.

cases.selection_method: Selected post hoc from erroneous seed-42 CNN output-only predictions with at most 30 response whitespace words and maximum softmax greater than 0.99; illustrative, not a population calibration estimate.
cases.prompt: In which Paris cemetery is Jacob Abraham Camille Pissarro’s youngest son buried?
cases.brief_response_quote: Jacob Abraham Camille Pissarro’s youngest son, **Paul-Émile Pissarro**, is buried in the **Père Lachaise Cemetery** in Paris.
cases.interpretation: High softmax does not guarantee correct attribution. The question concerns Camille Pissarro’s youngest son, named Paul-Émile Pissarro in the stored answer, not Camille Pissarro himself.
